$comment: Owners named by FND-01 deliverable 2 for root scripts that no workspace package implements yet.
tools/workspace-script.mjs prints `<name>: not implemented yet (owner: <ticket>, module <module>)`
and exits 0. Both the message and its test read this file, so they cannot drift apart.
PRD section 45.3 is normative: a command is never deleted from the list, only implemented by its owner.
